whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Siddharth Dental Clinic,

I noticed your clinic has a strong 4.5★ rating with 31 reviews in Kadamkuan, Patna, but lacks a dedicated mobile page for instant appointment booking.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website demo design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, treatment showcase, aur clinic timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/siddharth

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic (Siddharth Dental Clinic) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha.

Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?

[Branch A - If checked]
Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking for new patients and a clear treatment menu for services like RCT, implants, and smile design — right from mobile. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?

[Branch B - If not checked]
No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback.

[Closing]
Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual clinic photos, aur Dr. details integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
